lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repetitive grid-like arrangement of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the branchial slits, organized into distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, creating a lattice of anchor nodes most prominent in the central-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) swimming in close proximity to or attached to the ventral-lateral boundary.
